verdict.rationale: The pack documents general webhooks for account events, subscriptions and recurring invoices, and agent tooling (AgentOS MCP and CLI). None of it shows failed-payment events, automated payment retries, or dunning outreach. Those are generic building blocks an agent might use, not the product's own failed-payment and dunning capability, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor failed payments via API and webhooks and drive retries and dunning outreach
